plugins.name: uni-mcp
plugins.description: Out-of-the-box course assistant for university students using Canvas / Ed / Gradescope, built around the canvas-ed-mcp server. Ships the course-playbook knowledge layer (tool routing, pitfall heuristics, USYD browser routes) and a guided canvas-ed-mcp server install with keychain-stored credentials; the setup flow is in development.
